_meta.note: Mission Control messages shown in the radio bubble. Fictional lines written by the team. Keep them short so they fit the bubble.
_meta.note_nasa: Game file. Numbers here are game values, not NASA data.

messages.text: Mission Control to Outpost Zero. You have the outpost, Commander.
Orbiter sees a dust storm growing. Decide what stays on before the sun goes.
Battery is below forty percent. Shed a load now.
Battery is near the safe minimum. Cut something big.
Crew reports the habitat is getting cold.
Solar particle event. Get the crew into shelter.
Rover found ice nearby. Good news for the water tanks.
A clear day. Panels will run well today.
Outpost Zero is still standing. Nice work, Commander.
